survey.what_is_it: app/tool — a Claude Code skill run in a target repo: deterministic crawler, checker and viewer plus agent stages (structure, audit, explain, navigate)

architecture_rung.earned_by: the main session is the Structure agent and runs the dialogue; the audit swarm (one test per visual primitive) is parallelizable, verifiable read-only work. No parallel writers or seams that justify a fleet.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: crawler, canonical JSON and ids, overlay merge, conservation check (loupe-check), graph diffs. Agents write overlay and view only, never graph.json.

oracle_shape.goldens: invariants plus small goldens: fast = schema validation, loupe-check on every example, mutation tests, crawl-twice byte equality; full = HORDE at a pinned commit vs its golden graph, stress-case renders

consumed_by: horde (first client; the skill runs in horde's own sessions; .loupe/current/ gitignored there, snapshots only on loupe-history; .loupe/config.json human-owned (ADR 0021))

lifespan_autonomy.autonomy_tier: supervised: interactive sessions with Julian; no unattended runs
